description: HW7 Part 2/3 fixed verification cases over DomainStore.hw7_fixture() (10 records).

cases.prompt: Find the vulnerability record for the package 'openssl': search for it, then look up the full details of the first search result. Report its record id, severity and advisory code.
How many vulnerabilities in the inventory have critical severity? Answer with the count from the aggregate tool, then find one critical package as a supporting example and look up its full record.
Compare the packages lodash and log4j-core. Use one search for 'lo' to find both, then look up each record's details, and tell me which one is more severe and which one has more available copies.

error_recovery.prompt: Show me the full details of vulnerability record 4242.
